CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a locked-off static frame where only the subject moves on an 85mm short telephoto, framing with dead-centre symmetry with mirrored negative space.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with an overcast soft dome with no directional shadow at all; grade as a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.
